notes: retry.api.retry_call(job, exceptions=RuntimeError, tries=attempts, delay=0, logger=None) for each call; the error rethrown after the last attempt is caught. logger=None turns off its default warning per failed attempt, which would otherwise be printed to standard error. retry has no asynchronous API, so the function is a plain function and nothing is awaited, unlike the Python loop and the asyncio packages here. Between attempts it calls time.sleep(0), which returns at once.
